evaluation_basis: Assessed primarily as a representation-integrity experiment, exactly as documented; renderer/model smoke success is not a strategy-promotion result.
original_objective: Build deterministic causal ICT visual tensors and establish unsupervised, temporal and vision representation arms before multimodal ablation and any RL experiment.

engineering_result.summary: The repository contains causal rendering, no-future/model-shape tests, public-data vision smoke workflow, temporal runner and unsupervised representation runner.

scientific_result.summary: The design excludes ticker, time, axes, text, watermark, color conventions and future-shifted Ichimoku display, and requires downstream ablation before retaining a representation.

economic_result.summary: No verified evidence in the reviewed record establishes incremental post-cost out-of-sample trading value from vision, temporal or unsupervised embeddings.

limitations: Smoke benchmark used only three assets and two epochs
Representation quality does not prove tradable alpha
Minimum five-seed promotion requirement was separate from smoke execution
Multimodal ablation remained required before RL
contribution_to_next_version: Raised the integrity standard for causal representations and led to forensic correction of event ordering and portfolio risk state in v0.23.
